lead.title: Amphista doses first patient in Phase 1 trial of AMX-883, an oral BRD9 degrader, in acute myeloid leukaemia
lead.deck: The Cambridge biotech is testing its 'Targeted Glue' recruiting the DCAF16 E3 ligase in AML and high-risk MDS: about 54 patients planned (BRAMLIE trial, NCT07723703) after FDA clearance in June 2026. A clinical proof-of-concept milestone for the degrader class, ahead of any raise or licensing deal.

milestone.title: Elicera's ELC-301 CAR-T reaches 67% complete metabolic response in Phase I and gets the go-ahead for Phase IIa
milestone.summary: In 12 heavily pretreated B-cell lymphoma patients: no dose-limiting toxicity, 92% objective response and 100% disease control; the Swedish MPA authorises Phase IIa (6 patients, recruitment in Q4 2026).
milestone.why: A 4th-generation CD20 CAR-T (iTANK platform) clearing Phase I without dose-limiting toxicity is a rare milestone for a small listed Gothenburg biotech, ahead of a possible partnership.

deal.thesis: The Finnish biotech raises €28M in an oversubscribed round arranged by Springvest for three allergen immunotherapy programmes, including birch-allergy DM-101PX (Phase II BASIT, about 100 patients, results expected late 2026). Exit targeted after Phase II via licensing, M&A or IPO.

brefsEurope.title: Beacon Therapeutics meets the primary endpoint of the pivotal VISTA trial of laru-zova in X-linked retinitis pigmentosa
brefsEurope.summary: Gain of at least 15 letters at M12: 31.0% (high dose, p=0.0019) and 24.1% (low dose) vs 0%; macular sensitivity misses significance (p=0.0614). Rolling BLA submission targeted for late 2026.

brefsEurope.title: Oncopeptides detects melflufen in tumour tissue of the first three patients in the INSULA glioblastoma trial
brefsEurope.summary: Primary endpoint met at Oslo University Hospital, well tolerated; enrolment continues toward about 10 patients.

brefsEurope.title: After its Type A meeting, FDA requires additional clinical evidence for Ascelia's Orviglance
brefsEurope.summary: The FDA asks for a new study or a prospective analysis of the SPARKLE images; Ascelia does not plan a new study and prioritises Europe and a partner search.

brefsEurope.title: OnDosis teams up with US CDMO Adare for its US ADHD programme
brefsEurope.summary: Adare provides manufacturing services for Imfocy, extended-release amphetamine granules delivered via the Dosage Manager device; financial terms undisclosed.

brefsEurope.title: Concept Life Sciences appoints Adrijana Vinter as CEO
brefsEurope.summary: The former Global Head of Drug Discovery at Selvita and ex-CEO of Fidelta succeeds interim CEO Jonathan Critchley, who remains CFO.

brefsEurope.title: EPFL spin-off Baio Labs wins CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick for its Drugon generative-AI drug design platform
brefsEurope.summary: Founded by Ilia Igashov (CEO) and Arne Schneuing (CTO) with Prof. Bruno Correia (EPFL).

brefsIntl.title: Matchpoint Therapeutics raises $150M Series B co-led by Nextech Invest and Norwest
brefsIntl.summary: Sanofi Ventures, the T1D Fund and Atlas Venture participate; MPT-062, an oral T-cell modulator, enters the clinic in 2027.

brefsIntl.title: Genentech signs up to $1.27B Alector deal, with $100M upfront, for a blood-brain-barrier Parkinson's asset
brefsIntl.summary: AL050 (GCase, preclinical) is paired with Alector's 'Brain Carrier' technology: a valuation comparable for brain shuttles.

word.full: Brain Shuttle / BBB Shuttle (blood-brain barrier transport vehicle)
word.definition: A transport molecule (engineered antibody, peptide) that binds a blood-brain barrier receptor to carry into the brain a drug that could not enter on its own.

parts.label: Transport vector
parts.role: the passkey, bound to a barrier receptor

parts.label: Payload
parts.role: the drug (siRNA, enzyme, antibody, small molecule)

parts.label: Linker
parts.role: the attachment that tunes stability and release

how.t: The shuttle attaches to a receptor on the barrier cells' surface, such as the transferrin receptor.
The complex crosses the barrier by being carried through the endothelial cell.
The payload is released into brain tissue, where it acts on its neuronal target.

word.why: The barrier blocks most systemic drugs from the brain: shuttles are the key for biologics and RNA in neurology. Big pharma pays for access, as Genentech did with $100M upfront to Alector on Oct 5, 2026.

startups.name: Aerska
startups.use: Antibody–siRNA conjugates with a proprietary brain shuttle; €32M Series A in February 2026 led by EQT Dementia Fund and age1.

startups.name: Gate2Brain
startups.use: MiniAp4 peptide shuttle, candidate G2B-002 for brain tumours (FDA and EMA orphan designation); €7M from Shilpa Biocare in June 2026.

startups.name: Key2Brain
startups.use: VHH antibody platform targeting the transferrin receptor to boost biologics uptake in the brain; limited identified funding (April 2026 grant).
